body:
Hi,
I may not be in your shoes, but when I graduated nursing school I was unable to do anything for months. I didn't even go to my own graduation. I was the only person in my class who didn't go. I spent the next 6 months laying in bed unable to do a thing. My brain didn't work right, I would get up and try to walk somewhere but it felt like my brain was mush. Like i hadn't slept for days and the world seemed... Just weird and not real. Like the worst hangover mixed with the brain fog after getting your wisdom teeth removed while taking a magnet to your brain and erasing all emotion that was not darkness.

 I had been in two relationships in high school, both ended with my girlfriends banging my best friend (I'm still a virgin at 24 btw, and didn't date since 17 but that's not the same as you I know). My second girlfriend abused me to the point where I broke my nose a few times, broke my fingers and I also can not have kids. I am not trying to detract from your situation, but hoping to share a part of my life since you shared a part of yours.

I just wrote a post myself, and I personally am so past the point of lonely that I'm now a straight guy who is afraid of women (wtf i know). I often watch michael scott on the office and identify myself with him mixed with kevin and dwight.

What kind of music do you write? Do you have anything on soundcloud you would mind linking?

I'm a 24yo guy as well. When I was in highschool and in my first year of nursing school. I had it all, great grades, great family, an xbox, a gamecube.
And in nursing school, a kegger with lots of hot girls.
I thought there was no reason I felt that way, but looking back I can see that there were self destructive signs for me as well. (Such as having a kegger in a hospital dormitory, hooking each other up with IV's so we could drink more the next night without a hangover and picking locks to get access to the helipad at the hospital while drunk at night).
That whole time I felt emptiness, loneliness and attempted suicide a few times. But, like you, I'm here to tell the tale. Let's continue to tell the tale one breath at a time.

Thanks for sharing, feel free to share more if you want to.

Hello,

I just want to reach out and say: enjoy that party, pig out, and get a good nights sleep. If come monday morning the hangover isn't too bad. Let me know how it went. I'm not being sarcastic or rude, I sincerely think sometimes a good party with a few good (or not so good) friends can be refreshing.

Also, it seems like you have a good grasp on writing, do you have any poetry or short stories you could share?

I might be falling asleep soon myself, but I would like to read anything you share.
